| # Application program {#application-program-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                            |                                                                                                                                              |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The program flow is structured as follows:

 

1)The operating system is initialized after a reset, and is  a part of the BSW.

2)The preparations respective initializations for the application are now made. Callback functions, which are called for a specific event, can also be registered.

3)The application functions are called in the predefined application tasks
